notes.title: intermediate release 0.2.1 is now available as a beta branch
notes.notes:
This release contains the following upgrades:


 A technical upgrade of the java runtime from version 8 to 17 to help resolve the latest look & feel problems with high-resolution monitors, and a better support of windows scaling system.
This development was more intense than initially anticipated as many unforeseen problems arise during the development of the upgrade, requiring a greater test effort.
 An improved puzzle module with the following added features:

 The possibility to request an initial evaluation test that estimates your approximate tactical level and unlocks the according levels based on your test results.
It has to be noted that this functionality is only available if no previous tests have already been passed... 
If this is not more the case, resetting your global puzzle statistics is the only way to access this feature again.
 The possibility to adjourn an ongoing level test so it can be resumed later on that day, or another day.
 The possibility to store and display the results of the user's latest sessions when playing puzzles in free mode.

 Minor bugs corrections



How to use beta releases.
The following video shows how easily you can activate a Beta branch with the current Steam graphical interface : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H3YyeeaNrqo



.. A few words about future beta release 0.2.2


 The second part of the future Alpha Release 0.3.0 is already in the development phase..
It will feature a very interesting functionality where you can play against a Games database.
It will work at its best when you build a Games database containing the best games from the best Grand Masters in the world. 
You and your opponent will only be allowed to play moves that have been played within that database. If not, you will receive hints about the moves that are still available to you. 
You can then quickly and repetitively learn from the best players in the world, and also discover when they play different moves than what you would have played.
All moves played will be automatically analysed by the application's powerful position analyser, so you can then understand the reasons why grand master's moves are usually much better.
 A first version of a graphical resume will also be introduced that will feature pie chart diagrams displayed next to the global accuracy percentage of the players.
This resume will automatically display each time you finish analysing an endgame / a game against the computer or a game within a games database.
 Full support for Windows 11 players will also be added.

notes.title: Chess Exerciser, major alpha version 0.2.0 has been released
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=qpZZLOgp68M;full][/previewyoutube]
Added features
[olist]
Allow users to setup some basic look and feel preferences such as:

Changing the font size
Adding one of the predefined background image to the board or choose a custom image.
Setting up board colors, including the transparency level to accomodate the background image.
 
Improved screen layouts for supporting resolutions between 1366x768 and 3840x2160(4k)
Support for external chess engines, allowing users to add / remove and use any UCI compatible chess engine.
Added 4 easy engine analysis pre-configuration: 

Quick (10 seconds)
Moderate (30 seconds)
Strong (60 seconds)
Very Strong (120 seconds)
 
Configurable muti-threaded background analyser that can now take advantage of multicore CPUs.
Games databases allowing you to :	

create, delete, move, rename databases
mass import of games from correctly formatted external PGN files
mass export of games to PGN files
copy, move games from one database to another, delete games, or review past games.
automatically save your endgames or complete games against the computer to a games database.
setup separate engine configuration per database and run mass analysis.
 
Mistakes databases allowing users to :	

create, delete, move, rename databases
copy, move mistakes from one database to another, delete mistakes or review and comment mistakes.
automatically save approximations, small mistakes, big mistakes played in endgames or against the computer to a mistakes database.	
 
Puzzle analysis :	

after each played puzzle, users can now request a complete puzzle analysis with the possibility to configure the engine that will perform the analysis.
 
The assistant will now allow users to also play good moves or approximation moves next to the best move, when playing endgames or when playing against the computer.
And may more small enhancements...
[/olist]
Bugs solved	

(Major) When playing against the computer and pressing Ok to start a second game, and then trying to move the first piece as the white player  in 'best move' mode, the assistant was sometime providing incorrect hints, blocking the game.
(Minor) some Stacktraces were shown in the logs due double calls (in certain conditions) to the dialog setVisible() method.
